library.name: CanAirIO Air Quality Sensors Library
library.author: @hpsaturn, CanAirIO project <info@canair.io>
library.sentence: Air quality particle meter and CO2 sensors manager for multiple models.
library.paragraph: Generic sensor manager, abstratctions and bindings of multiple air sensors libraries: Honeywell, Plantower, Panasonic, Sensirion, Nova, etc. and CO2 sensors. Also it handling others environment sensors. This library is for general purpose but also is the sensors library base of CanAirIO project.

library.name: ESP32KeyBridge
library.author: TANAKA Masayuki
library.sentence: Bridge keyboard input to keyboard output on ESP32: remap, layers, macros, and layout conversion in between.
library.paragraph: ESP32KeyBridge sits between a keyboard and the machine that reads it. It takes input from USB Host keyboards, mice, gamepads and MIDI devices, BLE or Bluetooth Classic HID keyboards and mice, GPIO switches, key matrices and rotary encoders, normalizes it into one key model, merges several inputs into one, applies single-step remapping across key kinds, momentary layers, disabled keys, text macros and keyboard layout conversion, and writes the result to USB Device HID, BLE or Classic HID, or a serial Print. The core is portable C++ with no Arduino, ESP-IDF or hardware dependency; adapters are header-only, so a sketch needs EspUsbHost, EspUsbDevice or EspBle only for the adapters it includes. Bluetooth Classic is available only on the original ESP32.

library.name: SwitchBank
library.author: Little Man Builds (Darren Osborne)
library.sentence: Debounced 1..32-bit switch banks with explicit input validity and coherent packed reads.
library.paragraph: Header-only, Arduino-friendly switch-bank library for GPIO and expander-backed DIP, mode and selector inputs. Provides per-bit debounce, active-low/high normalization, coherent packed acquisition, explicit read-failure semantics, freshness/change metadata, durable sequence counters, edge helpers, and zero dynamic allocation. ESP32-S3 is the primary project target; portable compile gates cover AVR, megaAVR, SAMD, ESP32, ESP8266, RP2040, Teensy and STM32.

library.name: Universal_Button
library.author: Little Man Builds (Darren Osborne)
library.sentence: Debounced multi-button input with explicit reader validity, preserved interaction events, long-hold state, and latching.
library.paragraph: Header-only Arduino library for native GPIO, logical pressed-state callbacks, electrical-level callbacks, and validity-aware external readers. Provides per-button debounce/timing, short/double/long interaction classification, LongStarted/LongReleased semantics, a bounded event queue with overflow diagnostics, input freshness and sequence metadata, synchronized reconfiguration/recovery, optional latching, enum-friendly access, and zero dynamic allocation. ESP32-S3 is the primary project target; portable compile gates cover AVR, megaAVR, SAMD, ESP32, ESP8266, RP2040, Teensy and STM32.
